'''Perma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==History==
It served as the headquarters of the criminal organization known as the [[Perma families/Legends|Perma families]] and the one-time home of their lead [[Medic/Legends|medic]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]].<ref name="VisBattles" />
